votes.motion: Change the closing date of the town warrant for Annual Town Meeting to 4:00 p.m. on March 26, 2012, as recommended by the Town Manager.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved that they change the closing date of the town warrant, as recommended by the town manager to 4:00 p.m. on march 26, 2012. mr. sund seconded.

votes.motion: Approve the Class 1 License and the Class 3 License for Central Mass Motor Cycle LTD and Central Mass Power Sports doing business at 19 Massachusetts Ave.
votes.quote: mr. alonzo moved to approve the class 1 license and the class 3 license for central mass motor cycle ltd and central mass power sports doing business at 19 massachusetts ave.

votes.motion: Adjourn the regularly scheduled meeting to go into Executive Session under M.G.L. Chapter 39, Section 23B (3).
votes.quote: mir. debettencourt moved to adjourn the meeting. motion was seconded by mr. alonzo. the board voted unanimously to adjourn the meeting.

decisions.decision: The remote participation under Open Meetings Law Section 20 (d) item will be discussed again at a future meeting (not adopted at this meeting).

decisions.decision: Ms. Speidel to finish the BOS Policies & Procedures document and have it put back on the agenda for the following week.
decisions.quote: ms. speidel said she should be able to finish that up tomorrow and have it put back on the agenda for next week.

decisions.decision: Residents who have not had trash picked up under the new schedule are to call the BOS, which will arrange an alternate-day pickup.
decisions.quote: ms. speidel said that anyone who has not had their trash picked up to call the bos and they will arrange for it to be picked up on an alternate day.

decisions.decision: A reverse call will be made to Lunenburg residents about the solid waste schedule change, and it will be published in the Lunenburg Ledger.
decisions.quote: a "reverse call" will be made to lunenburg residents informing them of the schedule change, and it will also be published in the lunenburg ledger.
